title: My party game platform now has a 3D arcade lobby with proximity chat and its own minigames
author: ennuira93
selftext:
I've reached the point where the lobby has its own minigames, proximity voice chat and a claw machine.

I'm building [GameBuddies.io](http://GameBuddies.io), a browser-based platform with 21 multiplayer party games. This is the 3D side of its lobby, where your group can hang out, explore and decide what to play together.

You can switch between 2D and 3D whenever you want. That choice is personal, so one friend can use the 2D interface while another runs around the arcade. Everyone stays in the same room.

The lobby handles game voting, party playlists, chat, invites and your room's game history. In 3D, you can walk up to arcade cabinets to browse the platform's games and vote for what you want to play next.

There's also quite a bit to do before anyone hits Start: basketball, air hockey, a dance rhythm game, a claw machine, a clock tower jumping puzzle, and group minigames including bumper cars and Gabu Bowling.

Proximity voice chat lets conversations follow where people are standing. There's webcam support too, including an optional Gabu avatar that follows your facial movements.

Then there's the wardrobe, emotes, trails, entrance effects, photo booth, leaderboards and themed rooms with their own music. The video gives a tour of some of that.

I've been using Opus 5.5 and Astra 6 during development, with music from Suno.ai. A professional 3D artist is also rebuilding the Gabu character model.

Would be happy to get some feedback or even ideas :) Thank you!
